name: @repo/sync
description: Desktop vault-sync adapters over @repo/notes' pure engine: the node SyncManager (vault IO + hashing + base/blob stores under ~/.inteligir), the SyncAccount (Better Auth client, bearer token + config JsonStores, social sign-in state nonce), and the SyncCoordinator lifecycle (runtime gate, engine rebuild/teardown, conflict tracking). Host event emission is injected (setSyncEventSink) — this package never imports server/electron code.
